summary: Section A is mechanistically sound and bibliographically clean: all five cited sources are Tier 1 whitelisted (Diabetologia, Diabetes Care), first-author surnames and PMIDs for [1] and [2] verified against PubMed, formula constants (22.5 / 405) correct and internally consistent, hepatic-predominance claim accurately grounded in Tripathy [2], and all required rubric elements (HOMA1 vs HOMA2, proinsulin/renal-loss corrections, HOMA-%S/%B, clamp-needed caveat) present. Two sub-threshold notes not rising to HALT: (a) [4] Levy 1998 carries tag `cohort` but is a 2-page correction letter — `mechanism_review` would be more precise, though the rubric permits `cohort` for model/validation papers; (b) the text attributes the 40% variance finding to 'subjects with impaired glucose tolerance' whereas Tripathy's IFG/IGT subgroup includes both IFG and IGT, a minor terminological imprecision that does not misrepresent the finding.
